notes: Exhaustive collection of Vermont animal shelters, humane societies, rescue organizations, wildlife rehabilitators, farm sanctuaries, and support services. Major organizations include Humane Society of Chittenden County (founded 1901), Central Vermont Humane Society (50+ years), Lucy Mackenzie Humane Society (nearly 100 years, one of oldest no-kill shelters in US), Second Chance Animal Center (founded 1959), and Dorset Equine Rescue (Vermont's only GFAS-accredited equine rescue). Vermont has approximately 20 licensed wildlife rehabilitators. The Vermont Humane Federation was formed in 1990 by merger of organizations dating to late 1800s. Coverage spans all 14 Vermont counties with specialized services for dogs, cats, horses, farm animals, exotic pets, and wildlife.
